keyframe_review.note: The Free City was 'established on 15 November 1920'; in 1919 the land was still German. The shape is also 4,828 km2 against the page's 1,952 km2 (1928; ratio 0.40) because it carries the Memel Territory (2,657 km2 on the Klaipėda Region page; 1,952 + 2,657 = 4,609 against Cliopatria's 4,828), which was never part of Danzig. The gazetteer puts Tilsit's cell and the bbox up to 55.9N inside the shape. Do not draw this shape under this slug in 1919.

ledger.note: 15 November 1920: the Free City of Danzig is established. 'The country was established on 15 November 1920, per the terms of Article 100' of the Treaty of Versailles; a Danzig-Polish convention was signed on 9 November 1920; the infobox gives 1,952 km2 for 1928 and the first High Commissioner (Reginald Tower) dates from 1919-1920. The page gives districts (Danziger Höhe, Danziger Niederung, Großes Werder) but no boundary line: the region is Cliopatria's 1936 outline.

wars.note: The Invasion of Poland article was not opened (page budget); the dates are the Free City page's. The page also dates the Nazi takeover of the Senate to June 1933 (Volkstag election 28 May 1933), no territorial effect.

certainty.note: The frontier was fixed under Article 100 of the Treaty of Versailles and the page gives an exact area (1,952 km2, 1928) and the districts; the outline is Cliopatria's coarse 1936 shape.

notes:
TWO STATES IN ONE CLIOPATRIA ROW. Cliopatria's 'Free City of Danzig' (1809-1811 and 1919-1939) joins the Napoleonic Free City (21 July 1807 to 2 January 1814) and the interwar Free City (15 November 1920 to 1 September 1939), which Wikipedia treats as two articles. This dossier takes the interwar city and the shapes 1919-1939; the Napoleonic city is the new dossier free-city-of-danzig-1807-1814, which reviews the 1809 shape. (Each lists Cliopatria Name 'Free City of Danzig', so the validator warns that the other's shapes have no verdict.)

MEMEL TERRITORY. Cliopatria's 1919-1935 shapes (4,828 and 4,912 km2) include the Memel Territory (Klaipėda Region, 2,657 km2): German until the Treaty of Versailles, under French administration from 15 February 1920, annexed by Lithuania on 19 January 1923 (Klaipėda Region page), and 'mentioned only in passing' on the Danzig page. It was never Danzig's. Cliopatria's Kingdom of Lithuania row (1919-1939) may or may not carry it; the Lithuanian group should check. The Memel Territory 1920-1923 is a land under Allied administration that needs a dossier (suggested slug klaipeda-region).

NOT SETTLED. (1) The date the Versailles clause took effect is not on the Free City page; the Klaipėda page's infobox gives 'Treaty of Versailles: 10 January 1919' (sic) and its text '1920'. (2) 1 September or October 1939 for the formal annexation. (3) Danzig was a League of Nations-protected city under a High Commissioner; no page opened gives a ruler list, so identity.rulers is omitted. (4) The month of the 1920 found event is the establishment (15 November); from the treaty's entry into force the city was under Allied administration (Reginald Tower, first High Commissioner, 1919-1920), a period this dossier does not draw.
